# Pulse Analytics — free Next.js SaaS dashboard template

> A complete, MIT-licensed Next.js 16 template: a marketing site plus a working
> product-analytics dashboard. Every element of the interface, including all six charts,
> is built with VivekUI — a free React component library with zero runtime dependencies.
> Clone it, change the words, ship it.

Built with VivekUI — a free React component library with zero runtime dependencies:
91 accessible React components and 6 SVG charts, one install and one CSS import, no
Tailwind and no config. Created by Vivek Kumar Singh.

- Live demo: https://pulseanalytics.vivekkumarsingh.in
- Template repository: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/Pulse-Analytics
- Clone: `git clone https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/Pulse-Analytics.git`
- Install the library: `npm i @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui`
- Library documentation: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs
- Chart documentation: https://ui.vivekkumarsingh.in/docs/charts
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui
- GitHub (library): https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/vivek_UI
- Author: https://vivekkumarsingh.in/

## Who this is for

Developers and teams who want a finished Next.js SaaS starting point rather than a blank
`create-next-app`. It is a public template repository: clone or use "Use this template"
on GitHub, replace the mock data in `data/`, change the copy, and deploy. There is no
`.env` to fill in, no database, and no auth to unpick.

## Stack

- Next.js 16.3.x, App Router, Turbopack (the default bundler)
- React 19, TypeScript 5
- Node.js 20.9+ (22 LTS recommended)
- @the_viveksingh/vivek-ui 0.5.x — the only UI dependency
- No Tailwind, no shadcn, no MUI, no Recharts, no Chart.js, no D3

Full dependency list: `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `@the_viveksingh/vivek-ui`.

## Pages

- `/` — marketing homepage. The hero "screenshot" is not an image: it is a live panel
  rendering a real AreaChart and four real Sparklines.
- `/pricing` — three plans, a monthly/yearly Switch, a feature comparison Table, an FAQ.
- `/dashboard` — the charts showcase. Four KPI cards each with a Sparkline, plus an
  AreaChart, a BarChart, a LineChart, a PieChart and three ProgressRings.
- `/dashboard/customers` — a DataTable with sorting, search, pagination, row selection,
  status badges, avatars, row-action menus and an empty state.
- `/dashboard/roadmap` — a KanbanBoard with drag-and-drop and a full keyboard move path.
- `/dashboard/reports` — a date range, a four-chart grid, and an export that raises a Toast.
- `/built-with` — every component used, mapped to the section it draws and deep-linked
  to its documentation.

## The six charts

All six ship inside the component library. There is no chart library in package.json.

| Chart | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `AreaChart` | Revenue over the last 30 days |
| `BarChart` | Signups by channel; feature adoption (horizontal) |
| `LineChart` | Retention across three cohorts |
| `PieChart` | Plan mix, as a donut |
| `ProgressRing` | Three quarterly goals |
| `Sparkline` | The trend inside each KPI card |

Every chart is pure SVG with no measurement step, so all of them render in React Server
Components and appear in the HTML before any JavaScript executes. Each one also emits a
visually hidden data table, and distinguishes series by dash pattern and marker shape as
well as by colour, so the charts stay readable in greyscale and with any form of colour
blindness.

## Customising it

1. `lib/site.ts` — domain, repository URL and the UTM helper. `SITE.url` is what
   `metadataBase`, the canonical tags, the sitemap and every JSON-LD node derive from,
   so change it first.
2. `data/` — `analytics.ts`, `customers.ts` and `roadmap.ts` hold every number on the
   site as typed modules. Replace them with your own fetches; the chart shapes are the
   library's own types, so no transform layer is needed.
3. `lib/content.ts` — pricing plans, the comparison matrix and the FAQ (which also feeds
   the FAQPage structured data, so the two can never disagree).
4. `app/globals.css` — the accent lives in about eight CSS custom properties at the top.
5. `components/site/logo.tsx`, `app/icon.svg`, `app/opengraph-image.tsx` — the brand.
